scope: Pure, signed proof that one abstract child authority ceiling is equal to or narrower than a parent ceiling. No runtime delegation or effect admission is created.
core_invariant: A proof that authority was attenuated is not proof that the parent possessed delegation authority. Current AXIOM machine principals remain delegation-disabled and cannot use this laboratory to authorize child effects.

controls: child sets must be subsets of parent sets
action IDs must already exist in parent
every child numeric ceiling must be less than or equal to its parent ceiling
A-level assurance ordinal may only stay equal or increase
confirmation count may only stay equal or increase
parent required confirmation values must remain present

risks: same action name remapped to a different effector or destination
controls: global destination set must also attenuate
proof timestamps are signed evidence only and do not establish revocation/currentness
each transition consumes at least one depth
current Agent Passport maps to may_subdelegate=false and remaining_depth=0

risks: signed proof treated as bearer grant
proof treated as evidence parent was authorized to delegate
MCP/A2A/model/runtime switch used to widen authority
framework naming used as a new capability
controls: future authority-bearing record must bind exact parent authorization/currentness

known_nonclaims: This slice does not prove the parent was authorized to delegate.
This slice does not enable machine-principal delegation.
This slice does not implement descendant revocation propagation.
This slice does not implement a runtime child principal or execution grant.
Signed proof issuance/expiry timestamps do not establish that parent or child authority is currently active or unrevoked.
This slice does not claim currentness beyond supplied objects.
This slice does not modify the capability registry or supported effect path.
next_gates: A3b authority-bearing signed delegation record with an explicit reviewed parent delegation source
A6 ancestor currentness and revocation propagation before effect admission
A4 signed handoff only after an exact delegation head can be validated
confused-deputy and delegation-laundering conformance across protocol adapters
